newsitem.title: USA: Bass group has 14.3 pct Human Genome stake.
newsitem.headline: Bass group has 14.3 pct Human Genome stake.

text.p: A group including members of the Bass family of Fort Worth, Texas said Monday it holds a 14.3 percent stake or 3,158,766 shares in Human Genome Sciences Inc.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it holds shares of the Rockville, Md., genetic research company for investment purposes and may in the future purchase additional shares.
The group most recenly acquired 568,000 shares between Aug. 6 and Aug. 8 at $30.42 to $31.02 each, according to the SEC filing.
